Last Saturday, Max and Sam went to the school clinic. Max borrowed a book about math from the library. Sam is interested in dancing. Also, wash your dirty hands before dinner.
There are always many people at the park path. Max learned a lot about math. The weather was snowy that day. My bag hangs over one shoulder.
Max and Sam had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school clinic by bike. Max likes snowy days best. I twisted my ankle on the stairs.
The school clinic is one of the best places in the city. Max spent the weekend at the library. Both of them like fish and coffee.
